javax.microedition.broadcast.recording
Interface RecordingSchedulerListener

public interface RecordingSchedulerListener

A listener to monitor the scheduled recordings list. It is intended for the application to implement this interface and pass an instance to the RecordingScheduler.addListener method.

Method Summary
 void listUpdated()

Method Detail

listUpdated

void listUpdated()
Called when the RecordingScheduler's list was updated. This can be caused by either native application changing something in the list or by Java application doing the same thing. This is called if a Recording was added to the list or if a Recording was removed from the list; state changes of Recordings do not cause a call of this method.

stateChanged

void stateChanged(Recording recording,
                  int newState)
Called when a state of a Recording has changed.

Parameters:
recording - The recording whose state was changed.
newState - The new state of the Recording.
